doc:
# Conductivity — Superconductors

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “holographic conductivity”).

claims.name: holographic_edge_states_correctly_reproduce
claims.statement: Holographic edge states correctly reproduce Hall conductivity

sources.title: Fractional Quantum Hall Effect via Holography: Chern-Simons, Edge States, and Hierarchy

claims.name: dual_holographic_dc_conductivity_computed
claims.statement: The dual holographic DC conductivity is computed.

sources.title: Axionic black branes in the k-essence sector of the Horndeski model

claims.name: holographic_system_optical_conductivity_computed
claims.statement: The holographic system’s optical conductivity is computed numerically.

sources.title: Lifshitz holographic superconductor in Horava-Lifshitz gravity

claims.name: holographic_conductivity_exhibits_expected_meanfieldlike
claims.statement: The holographic conductivity exhibits the expected mean-field-like behavior.

claims.name: dc_current_affects_ac_conductivity
claims.statement: The DC current affects the AC conductivity of the holographic superconductor.

sources.title: On Holographic Superconductors with DC Current

claims.name: holographic_prescription_dc_conductivity_disordered
claims.statement: A holographic prescription for DC conductivity in disordered systems is provided.

claims.name: holographic_conductivity_studied_twodimensional_systems
claims.statement: Holographic conductivity is studied for two-dimensional systems such as graphene.

sources.title: Thermodynamics and gauge/gravity duality for Lifshitz black holes in the presence of exponential electrodynamics

claims.name: mechanism_negative_differential_conductivity_holographic
claims.statement: The mechanism for negative differential conductivity in holographic conductors is clarified.

sources.title: Mechanism for Negative Differential Conductivity in Holographic Conductors

claims.name: holographic_computation_conductivity_weakly_disordered
claims.statement: A holographic computation of the conductivity of weakly disordered strange metals is carried out, including average conductivity and sample-to-sample fluctuations.

sources.title: Conductivity of weakly disordered strange metals: from conformal to hyperscaling-violating regimes

claims.name: abstract_indicates_possible_bounds_conductivity
claims.statement: The abstract indicates possible bounds on conductivity are considered using holographic duality.

claims.name: bulk_metric_successfully_extracted_boundary
claims.statement: The bulk metric is successfully extracted from boundary holographic optical conductivity data.

sources.title: Deep learning bulk spacetime from boundary optical conductivity

claims.name: conductivity_jumps_analogous_previously_studied
claims.statement: The conductivity jumps are analogous to previously studied jumps of holographic entanglement.

sources.title: Direct photons emission rate and electric conductivity in twice anisotropic QGP holographic model with first-order phase transition

claims.name: incoherent_conductivity_computed_holographic_spatially
claims.statement: The incoherent conductivity is computed for holographic spatially modulated breaking translations spontaneously.

sources.title: Incoherent conductivity of holographic charge density waves

claims.name: experimental_magnetoconductivity_data_well_fit
claims.statement: The experimental magneto-conductivity data are well fit by the holographic theory.

sources.title: Small Fermi Surfaces and Strong Correlation Effects in Dirac Materials with Holography

claims.name: electric_conductivity_holographic_metal_depends
claims.statement: The electric conductivity of the holographic metal depends on the doping parameter.

claims.name: conductivity_holographic_superconductor_calculated_analytical
claims.statement: The conductivity of the holographic superconductor is calculated by the analytical method.

sources.title: Holographic superconductor with nonlinear Born - Infeld-type electrodynamics

claims.name: work_applies_holographic_methods_conductivity
claims.statement: The work applies holographic methods to conductivity in disordered $2+1$ dimensional systems.

claims.name: conductivity_computed_holographic_model_energy
claims.statement: Conductivity is computed in the holographic model and the energy gap is extracted.
